title: Cross-instance SonarQube migration request
$comment: AUTHORITATIVE copy. The copy present in sonar-migration-requests is informational: validation never reads its contract from the repository the requester can modify.

version.$comment: Contract version. Any incompatible change increments this number.

instance_source.$comment: Source instance identifier, as published in docs/instances-disponibles.md. One entity = one instance.

cle_source.$comment: Strict whitelist: no shell interpolation anywhere, keys are passed as named parameters to HTTP calls.

cle_cible.$comment: Key generated by the DevOps portal when the space was created.

ticket.$comment: Context only: copied into the report and the journal, never used in a decision.

fenetre_souhaitee.$comment: Indicative. The actual window is chosen by the central team when the manual job is launched.

commentaire.$comment: Bounded free text. Escaped before any Markdown rendering, never interpolated.
